raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

`--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp"}'` fails to load mixed Quark DeepSeek-V4 checkpoints (FP8 attention / shared experts + NVFP4 routed experts). The draft modules are constructed under `model.layers.{num_hidden_layers + i}.*`, but `_make_deepseek_v4_weights_mapper` rewrites Quark `layer_quant_config` keys from `mtp.{i}.*` to `model.mtp.{i}.*`. Per-layer lookups miss, every MTP linear falls back to the global NVFP4 scheme, and `PackedColumnParameter.load_merged_column_weight` then asserts on a packed vs unpacked shape mismatch.

This is independent of the ROCm PDL warmup fix in #56035.

## Changes

- Add `align_mtp_quant_config()` to re-key `model.mtp.{i}.` onto the draft prefixes before MTP construction.
- Give `DeepSeekV4MTP` the same `packed_modules_mapping` as `DeepseekV4ForCausalLM` so fused `gate_up_proj` / `fused_wqa_wkv` unfold to `w1`/`w3` and `wq_a`/`wkv` for per-layer lookup.
- Apply on amd / nvidia / xpu MTP classes (same mapper mismatch exists on all three).

## Test plan

- [x] `vllm serve` DeepSeek-V4-Flash-NVFP4 on 8× gfx950, TP=8, `--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":1}'`
- [x] MTP weights load (`MTP draft model loaded: 39 params`)
- [x] Greedy completion and a short chat request succeed
- [x] Speculative acceptance is non-zero (46/51 draft tokens accepted ≈ 90%)


## Test result

ROCm serve reached `Application startup complete`. `/health` 200. Greedy `"The capital of France is"` produced `" Paris."`; chat `"Name three prime numbers greater than 100"` produced `"101, 103, 107"`. Spec decode metrics: 51 draft tokens, 46 accepted.

@tjtanaa  Validated MTP on 8× gfx950 with TP=8 and `num_speculative_tokens=1` using both checkpoints:

**Official DeepSeek checkpoint — `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`**
- MTP draft model loaded successfully: 39 params
- Health check and greedy completion succeeded
- GSM8K 8-shot strict exact match: 94.62%
- Draft acceptance stayed around 95–97%

**AMD Quark checkpoint — `amd/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-NVFP4`**
- MTP draft model loaded successfully: 39 params
- Health check and greedy completion succeeded
- GSM8K 8-shot strict exact match: 93.71%
- Draft acceptance stayed around 95–96%

The merged ROCm JIT warmup fix from #56035 was applied for both runs. This confirms the Quark-specific remapping works and does not regress MTP loading with the original DeepSeek checkpoint.
Thanks for your commenta!

     _MTP_SHARED_HEAD_RMSNORM_KERNEL,
 )
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.quant_config import align_mtp_quant_config
 from vllm.platforms import current_platform
 from vllm.sequence import IntermediateTensors
 
 from .mega_moe import finalize_mega_moe_weights
-from .model import DeepseekV4DecoderLayer
+from .model import DeepseekV4DecoderLayer, DeepseekV4ForCausalLM
 
 logger = init_logger(__name__)
 
@@ -289,10 +290,15 @@ def get_top_tokens(
 
 
 class DeepSeekV4MTP(nn.Module):
+    # The draft head reuses DeepseekV4DecoderLayer, so its fused linears must
+    # unfold to the same checkpoint shards for per-layer quant config lookup.
+    packed_modules_mapping = DeepseekV4ForCausalLM.packed_modules_mapping
+
     def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
         super().__init__()
         self.config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
         self.quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+        align_mtp_quant_config(self.quant_config, self.config)
         self.model = DeepSeekV4MultiTokenPredictor(
             vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model")
         )

@@ -21,11 +21,41 @@
 _DEEPSEEK_V4_EXPERT_DTYPES = ("fp4", "fp8")
 
 if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from transformers import PreTrainedConfig
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import QuantizationConfig
     from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.modelopt import (
         ModelOptNvFp4Config,
     )
 
 
+def align_mtp_quant_config(
+    quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None, config: PreTrainedConfig
+) -> None:
+    """Re-key the quant config's MTP entries onto the draft module prefixes.
+
+    ``_make_deepseek_v4_weights_mapper`` renames the checkpoint's ``mtp.{i}.``
+    layers to ``model.mtp.{i}.``, but the draft modules are built under
+    ``model.layers.{num_hidden_layers + i}.``. Without this remap no per-layer
+    entry matches, so every MTP linear falls back to the global scheme. On a
+    mixed checkpoint (FP8 attention and shared experts, NVFP4 routed experts)
+    that builds NVFP4 parameters for FP8 weights and the load then fails a
+    shape assertion.
+    """
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import WeightsMapper
+
+    if quant_config is None:
+        return
+    quant_config.apply_vllm_mapper(
+        WeightsMapper(
+            orig_to_new_prefix={
+                f"model.mtp.{i}.": f"model.layers.{config.num_hidden_layers + i}."
+                for i in range(config.num_nextn_predict_layers)
+            }
+        )
+    )
+
+

     """FP8 config for DeepSeek V4 with expert-dtype-aware MoE dispatch.
